Docs.summary: Provides the On-Device Personalization (ODP) APIs, which let an app run a service in an isolated process to personalize content with on-device data.
Docs.remarks: Apps use to run an . The service creates an for each request. The worker can generate content to display in the app, and it can write results to on-device storage for federated analytics and federated learning. The calling app cannot read the displayed content or the stored results directly. These APIs are deprecated in Android API level 37. See the Android source and the Android package reference.
